prompt: Give me a 14 days travel to Dublin
response: A 14-day trip to Dublin can be packed with rich experiences. Start with a visit to the Guinness Storehouse and St. Patrick's Cathedral. Explore the vibrant Temple Bar district for music and culture. Don't miss the chance to see the Book of Kells at Trinity College. Dublin Castle offers insights into the city's history. With its compact size, you can easily explore the city's highlights on foot.
